text.tspan: Principles on How to Be a Proper Human Being — General
My snacks and my muffins, my favorite truck or hat;
My colors, my markers; I’m sharing this and that.
It’s not because I have to, and it’s not with a pity-pout!
When we share with everyone we’re happy — there’s no doubt.
